fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. (V) is expanding its 'Agentic Ready' program for AI agent-based commerce, with over 140 participating companies including Adyen, Fiserv, PayPal, and Stripe participating at launch
fields.summary_ko.1: Visa's framework supports testing of agent authentication, tokenized credentials, and fraud prevention, which can offer transaction volume preservation and value creation opportunities as AI agents play a larger role in commerce
